nodes.description: Constant of 86400 seconds per day used for time unit normalization and release math.
Immutable ERC20 token address held and distributed by the timelock.
Immutable address of the beneficiary receiving released tokens.
Immutable start timestamp (day-aligned) of the release period.
End timestamp of the release period; mutable, rewritten on terminate().
Total benefit amount; mutable, reduced on terminate().
Running total of already withdrawn tokens by the beneficiary.
Flag indicating the timelock contract has been terminated.
Owner address stored by Ownable; controls privileged functions.
Initializes token, beneficiary, day-aligned release window, total benefit and validates end time against block.timestamp.
View getter returning the held ERC20 token.
View getter returning the beneficiary address.
View getter returning the total benefit amount.
Computes vested amount from block.timestamp relative to release window; returns 0 before start and full total after end.
Returns total benefit minus released balance.
View getter returning the already withdrawn balance.
Withdraws the newly released amount to the beneficiary after updating internal accounting, then transfers tokens.
Owner-only termination: freezes total benefit to released amount, resets end time to current day and sends remaining tokens to the owner.
Ownable getter returning the current owner address.
Owner-only function setting the owner to the zero address.
Owner-only function transferring ownership to a new non-zero address.
Internal Ownable helper that mutates _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Context helper returning msg.sender.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks and privileged access control.
Miner/validator-influenced timestamp driving release schedule computation and constructor validation.
External ERC20 safeTransfer to _beneficiary inside withdraw(), executed after state update.
External ERC20 safeTransfer of remaining balance to owner() inside terminate().
Constructor ERC20 token parameter assigned to _token.
Constructor beneficiary address parameter assigned to _beneficiary.
Constructor release start timestamp, day-aligned via modulo then stored.
Constructor number of timelock days used to derive the release end time.
Constructor total benefit amount assigned to _totalBenefit.
New owner address passed to transferOwnership and forwarded to _setOwner.
Local in releasedBalance: elapsed whole days since release start.
Local in releasedBalance: total whole days of the release period.
Local in withdraw: newly released amount to be transferred.
Local in terminate: residual token balance to send to the owner.
Local in _setOwner: previous owner value used in the emitted event.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is assigned to state variable _token.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is assigned to _beneficiary.
Day-aligned releaseStartTime_ is stored into _releaseStartTime.
releaseStartTime_ contributes to the computed _releaseEndTime.
daysOfTimelock_ is multiplied by SECONDS_OF_A_DAY to derive _releaseEndTime.
Constructor parameter totalBenefit_ is assigned to _totalBenefit.
Constructor uses SECONDS_OF_A_DAY for day alignment and end time math.
Constructor require() compares _releaseEndTime with block.timestamp, making deployment timestamp-dependent.
_msgSender() returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
Owner initialization passes _msgSender() into _setOwner.
_setOwner writes the new value into the _owner state variable.
Deployment chains into Ownable initialization which invokes _setOwner.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership calls _setOwner(address(0)).
onlyOwner modifier authorizes renounceOwnership based on the untrusted msg.sender.
transferOwnership calls _setOwner with the validated new owner.
newOwner parameter flows into _setOwner.
onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership depends on the untrusted msg.sender.
_setOwner reads the previous _owner into the local oldOwner.
releasedBalance branching and vesting percentage are entirely derived from block.timestamp.
releasedBalance uses _releaseStartTime to compute elapsed days.
releasedBalance uses _releaseEndTime to bound the vesting window.
releasedBalance scales _totalBenefit by the elapsed fraction of the period.
passedDays local is computed as (block.timestamp - _releaseStartTime) / SECONDS_OF_A_DAY.
totalDays local is computed from the release window length.
unreleasedBalance subtracts releasedBalance() from _totalBenefit.
unreleasedBalance calls releasedBalance() for the vested amount.
withdraw requires releasedBalance() to exceed the already withdrawn amount.
withdraw reads _withdrawedBalance for the delta computation and requirement.
withdraw computes the local amount as releasedBalance() - _withdrawedBalance.
withdraw resolves the token contract through token()/_token for the balance check and transfer.
The computed amount is passed to the external safeTransfer call.
_beneficiary is the recipient of the safeTransfer.
withdraw performs an external token transfer that can hand control to an untrusted token contract.
withdraw increases _withdrawedBalance by the withdrawn amount.
terminate is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier which calls owner().
onlyOwner compares owner() with the untrusted msg.sender, gating termination.
terminate freezes _totalBenefit to the currently released balance.
terminate reads _totalBenefit to compute the residual amount.
terminate resets _releaseEndTime using the day-aligned block.timestamp.
terminate rewrites the _releaseEndTime state variable.
terminate sets _isTerminated to true.
terminate computes amountToWithdraw from the token balance minus unreleased benefit.
terminate performs an external token transfer to the owner after mutating state.
amountToWithdraw is the value passed to the safeTransfer call.
owner() supplies the recipient address for the residual token transfer.

Constructor parameter only exists to initialize the _beneficiary state variable; fold it into the constructor core node.
Constructor parameter is day-aligned and stored into _releaseStartTime and _releaseEndTime; fold it into the constructor.
Constructor parameter is used only to derive _releaseEndTime; fold it into the constructor.
Constructor parameter only exists to initialize _totalBenefit; fold it into the constructor.
Parameter is declared by and used only within transferOwnership before being forwarded to _setOwner; fold it into that function.
Temporary local used only inside releasedBalance to compute the vested fraction; fold it into that function.
Temporary local used only inside releasedBalance as the vesting denominator; fold it into that function.
Temporary local holding the withdrawal amount before it is sent to the beneficiary; fold it into withdraw.
Temporary local holding the residual balance transferred to the owner; fold it into terminate and its unsafe_operation safeTransfer_terminate.
Temporary local capturing the previous owner for the event; fold it into _setOwner.
